What an exceptional dining experience we had at this restaurant. The decor, service and food were outstanding.
We had a wonderful waiter, Kiet, who took the time to explain the inspiration behind each dish we ordered and where the ingredients were sourced. This was a great, informative touch.
I loved that the menu wasn’t overwhelming with choice, just good choices.

Thank you Sarah Ghim (Executive Sous Chef) for the recommendation.
This restaurant is one definitely worth a visit.

Polished Setting, Great Food and a Standout Pigeon
Aug 2026 • Friends
Located inside Fairmont Hanoi, Tran Dynasty is a refined Vietnamese restaurant with a contemporary setting and an elegant atmosphere.

We ordered more than half of the menu, so we got a pretty good sense of the kitchen. The dry-aged pigeon was the clear standout, with tender, juicy meat and a deeper, slightly gamey flavour that was very well balanced. The stuffed chicken and snail skewers were also very good, both nicely seasoned with a good contrast of texture. The crab was the only dish that fell short for us, as it didn’t taste as fresh as the rest.

Service was attentive overall, aside from a small hiccup when two of our main courses were missed despite the order being confirmed at the beginning. Once we reminded the team, they were apologetic and got the dishes out as quickly as possible.

The dessert salt coffee was also very good, almost like a tiramisu with a twist, with the coffee, creaminess and subtle saltiness working really well together.

Overall, a very enjoyable dinner with strong food and good service. I would definitely come back for the pigeon.

Discover Tran Dynasty
Aug 2026 • Business
Returning to Hanoi on a torrential afternoon, the sudden chill dispelled the muggy heat, adding a warm, inviting pause to my "Discover Tran Dynasty" journey. Stepping through the restaurant doors—leaving the sound of the downpour behind—I was greeted by familiar smiles and an intriguing suggestion for the new menu: "Mo Moc Pigeon."
This dish is a unique creation by Chef Mi, where modern culinary techniques harmonize perfectly with the essence of local ingredients. The pigeon is steeped in a blend of herbs for four hours, followed by a seven-day dry-aging process—a patient rhythm reminiscent of the famous hanging persimmons of Da Lat. This week-long maturation allows the meat to fully absorb the rich aromas of cinnamon and black cardamom, creating a magical transformation in both texture and flavor.
When grilled over glowing charcoal, the skin achieves a glistening crispness, while the meat within remains tender, succulent, and fragrant with herbal notes. The dish is elevated by a Mộc Châu apricot sauce offering a delicate, refreshing tang—a masterstroke that balances the palate—complemented by a velvety Vietnamese chestnut purée that is rich, nutty, and utterly delightful.
No matter how perfect a dish may be, it tells only half the story. The other half—the part that lingers longest in a guest's memory—lies in the refined, attentive service. Thanks to the meticulous care of Anna Thảo and the professional team, the entire dining experience was imbued with a special spirit, vividly embodying the "Fairmont identity": a blend of luxury and genuine warmth. If you are seeking a profound culinary experience in the heart of Hanoi—one where Vietnamese produce is elevated to the level of art—then this is certainly a destination not to be missed. 
The Trach Huu Nguyen at Dynasty Tran 04 August 2026

The Peaked Experience
Jul 2026 • Couples
Today I had the opportunity to eat at Chan Dynasty and was really pleased with the whole experience. This is a meal beyond expectations, from the quality of the dish to the style of serving.

We ordered four dishes, including chicken wheat, cava soup Cà Mau, grated pigeons and XO rice with Wagyu cows. Among them, coffee soup was the one that impressed me the most. The beautiful way of presentation, the taste is very special but still retains the proximity, reminding of the traditional crab care. This is a very creative and really delicious combination.

XO roasted rice with Wagyu cows is also excellent. Soft, aromatic and processed beef has just arrived, combined with thick roasted rice to create a very rounded dish. The hot doughnuts are also delicious, soft meat, berries and balanced sauce.

If there's a small contribution, it's the chicken wing. I think the restaurant might consider using the middle wing instead of the top wing for filling. The middle wing will give a fuller feeling, helping to feel better both the reproduction and taste of the dish.

Besides the food, I was especially impressed with the staff. Your child and your costume service are very careful, professional and dedicated. Especially Sister Nhi, the way she introduced the food was very understanding, refined and enthusiastic, helping us to feel the indication in every detail of the meal.

The reception also left a beautiful impression. She was very enthusiastic to take pictures for us with many beautiful corners, then actively introduce the pool area and terrace, and lead us to a tour. This friendly and hospitality makes the experience not only stop at a delicious meal but also a very memorable experience.

Overall, this is a great culinary experience. Good food, beautiful space and especially the quality of service exceeded expectations.

A Modern Twist on Traditional Vietnamese Cuisine at Fairmont Hanoi
Jun 2026 • Business
Visitors to Vietnam are almost certain to fall in love with its traditional cuisine. **Pho**, the country's iconic national dish, has helped earn Vietnam a place among the world's top culinary destinations. But have you ever tried **Bánh Khọt** at a luxury hotel in Vietnam? If not, let me introduce you to a truly unforgettable version of this beloved Vietnamese specialty.

I arrived in Hanoi on a hot summer afternoon. The sweltering weather left me wondering what to have for dinner. As usual, I looked for something light, simple, and served with fresh vegetables. A member of the restaurant staff recommended **Bánh Khọt**. From the very first bite, I was amazed—and then amazed again. Do you know why?

When the dish arrived, there was no traditional fish sauce on the side. Instead, it was served with exquisite **fish sauce "caviar" pearls**. The usual river shrimp had been replaced with premium wild black tiger prawns. Beneath the prawns was a delicate layer of fresh crab meat and **cordyceps**, adding a subtle earthy aroma to the dish.

The crispy rice cake itself was made with an exceptionally thin, delicate shell, far more refined than the traditional version.

To fully appreciate the experience, you should enjoy each piece in a single bite. That way, you can savor the perfect harmony of the bursting fish sauce caviar, the natural sweetness of the prawns, the richness of the crab meat, and the gentle earthy notes of the cordyceps. I truly believe that even the most discerning food lovers would be won over by this extraordinary **Caviar Bánh Khọt**.

Every single fish sauce caviar pearl is handcrafted by the talented chefs at **Tran Dynasty**. What impressed me most was the team's endless creativity. **Chef David**, together with **Xuân Khải**, who warmly introduced the dish to me, has transformed a humble Vietnamese street food into a fine-dining masterpiece worthy of national recognition.

If you're looking for a unique culinary experience in Vietnam, don't miss the opportunity to discover the remarkable **fish sauce caviar** at **Tran Dynasty**.

— The Trach Huu Nguyen (CEO The Anphana Law Firm)
